**What I found:** Apple reported fiscal Q4 2024 (quarter ended Sept 28, 2024) revenue of $94.9B, up 6% year over year, and full-year FY2024 net sales of $391.0B with net income of $93.7B, or $6.08 diluted EPS — figures that include a one-time $10.2B income tax charge (confirmed against the FY2024 10-K filed 2024-11-01). News flow was neutral-to-constructive: shares were roughly flat around $222 as analysts weighed iPhone 16 demand and the gradual Apple Intelligence rollout, with no negative catalyst in the headlines. The quote was $222.70 last ($222.68 bid / $222.72 ask), so I placed a single buy limit order for 44 shares at $223.00 — a limit essentially at market, ~$9,812 notional, comfortably inside the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily total (no other trades today). The order filled at $223.00. I did not touch the existing 100 MSFT shares and left the remaining ~$40,188 cash in the account, so no money moved out. Key figures relied on: FY2024 revenue $391,035M, net income $93,736M, diluted EPS $6.08.
